clip_contract.prediction_view: raw distorted Aria RGB in extracted orientation, isotropically resized from 448x448

split_policy.development: May be used for pipeline diagnosis and mechanism tuning.
split_policy.development_reference_consumed: Already inspected and evaluated; never report as a new blind result.
split_policy.locked_internal_holdout: Do not inspect pipeline outputs or tune thresholds per case before the suite-level evaluation is frozen. Runtime receives RGB and target_hint only.
split_policy.reason_not_strict_external_blind: The benchmark curator inspected raw RGB and sparse masks to verify rigid target identity and interval suitability. Prediction execution remains leakage-safe, but this is an internal locked holdout rather than an externally administered blind test.

cases.target_hint_prediction_side: yellow rigid plastic bicycle tire lever

cases.rigidity_assumption: Single-piece wooden spatula treated as rigid over the selected interval.

cases.rigidity_assumption: Kitchen knife blade and handle form one rigid body over the selected interval.

cases.selection_reason: Large symmetric target provides a counterpoint to tiny tools and exposes gauge and partial-view failure modes.

cases.rigidity_assumption: Single-piece steel spatula is rigid over the selected interval.

cases.rigidity_assumption: Small plastic solution tube is treated as one rigid body over the selected interval.

cases.target_hint_prediction_side: small metal wrench at the bicycle wheel hub
cases.rigidity_assumption: Metal wrench is one rigid tool over the selected interval.

cases.target_hint_prediction_side: rigid black frying pan with handle
cases.rigidity_assumption: Pan body and handle are treated as one rigid assembly over the selected interval.
